messages.en:
{07 16 00}I don't know what my
problem is, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} I
haven't caught a fish yet!
{07 0b 00}What say you give me some
more time, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma ei tea, mis mul viga
on, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} Ma pole
veel ühtegi kala püüdnud!
{07 0b 00}Mis sa ütled, kui annaksid
mulle veel aega, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I hate to admit it, but{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}
I still haven't caught a
worthwhile fish.
{07 14 00}It would be super if you'd
give me just a little more
time, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma ei tahaks öelda, aga{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}
ma pole ikka veel ühtegi
väärt kala püüdnud.
{07 14 00}Oleks super, kui sa annaksid
mulle veel natuke
aega, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}have you

fish yet?
{07 16 00}I'm not pressuring you!{01 00 00 05 00}
I haven't caught anything
yet either. Be patient!

{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}kas sa oled
